newsitem.title: USA: LaBarge wins $1.4 million Air Force contract.
newsitem.headline: LaBarge wins $1.4 million Air Force contract.

text.p: LaBarge Inc said Thursday it has been awarded a one year contract valued at $1.4 million to produce printed circuit board assemblies for use in a U.S. Air Force radar system.
Lockheed Martin Corp's Material Acquisition Center - Mid-Atlantic Region in Moorestown, N.J., awarded the contract on behalf of its Ocean, Radar & Sensor Systems division in Syracuse, N.Y..
LaBarge will build the assemblies at its facility in Tulsa, Okla.
LaBarge designs and makes custom electronic products and interconnect systems for telecommunications, geophysical, medical, aerospace and defense.
